title: Add to project drops a card's name (was: cardName ignored on a Flow submit)
description: The Flow-path premise was false: the unnamed cards were Add-to-project copies, which wrote customName null. Fix the copy; pin nameCard's open branch; prove a Flow cardName into a closed project live. Evidence in validation.md.
